content.text:
An analysis of the examples reveals the following transformation rule:

- The grid contains several 4x4 blocks along the main diagonal (each block has a single dominant base color, though in some cases individual pixels inside the block might be corrupted or replaced with another color).
- Outside these 4x4 diagonal blocks, there are scattered single "noise" pixels.
- The output simply restores every 4x4 diagonal block to be entirely solid with its dominant color, and removes all other pixels outside the diagonal blocks (sets them to `0` / background).

I am ready for the test input.
